title: Jessie James Charters

services.name: Fishing - Inshore
services.desc: Hey there, angler! Ready for the fishing trip of a lifetime? Captain Mark Schrenk and the crew at Jessie James Charters have got you covered with our 12-hour offshore extravaganza. We're talking about heading way out into the blue waters of the Atlantic, where the big boys play. Whether you're a seasoned pro or it's your first time chasing pelagics, we'll make sure you're in for a day you won't forget. Picture this: You're aboard our top-notch fishing vessel, the salt spray in your face as we cruise out of Atlantic City. The skyline fades, and it's just you, the crew, and the endless ocean. We're not messing around with the small fry here - we're after the heavyweight champs of the sea.
